text:
Asha: quick preflight for Acme Health POC — need to lock scope, acceptance KPIs, and an answer on burst pricing + KMS. customer wants a 1-week internal eval starting next Tue. @Diego can you own prompts/evals? Also @Mira we need a checklist for private deployment requirements.
Diego: I’ll lead the eval. plan: 200 prompt variations across the 3 main flows (summary, entity extraction, rerank). automated harness + 20 manual spot checks. propose quality thresholds: BERTScore-ish >=0.82 and hallucination rate <3%.
Mira: Ops constraints: since this is PHI-adjacent, private deployment in their VPC + KMS is required. I need the customer KMS ARN and their network CIDRs to finish firewall rules. infra prep estimate: 5 business days after we have those.
Ken: Product acceptance KPIs (proposal): p50 latency <= 150ms, p95 <= 400ms, p99 <= 700ms at target load (20 RPS sustained). Cost guardrail: <= $150 per 1M tokens (in+out) for typical prompt mix. Also require deterministic fallback policy (smaller model or cached response) on capacity pressure.
Sam: Pricing quick note — for Dedicated reserved + burst the rough outline: reserved pool baseline $3,200/mo, burst at $0.06 per 1k tokens. If they want commit discount or longer term, we can tighten. Will confirm exact quoting numbers with finance tomorrow.
Asha: security Qs from customer: SOC2 report, EU data residency, and KMS attestation. Mira, can you confirm which docs we can share and any redactions?
Mira: We can share SOC2 summary and EU region deployment. For KMS attestation we need to run the integration test with their team — requires access to service account perms.
Diego: Eval plan details: run 100k tokens across the prompt suite (10 prompts x 200 variants). Metrics: semantic similarity (BERTScore >=0.82), exact-match for structured extraction >= 88%, hallucination <3%. We'll export eval results + failure examples. I’ll attach prompt suite by EOD.
Asha: operational checklist (high level):
```
- customer KMS ARN + service account
- VPC peering / CIDR allowlist
- prompt suite & golden examples
- target traffic profile (RPS, burst pattern)
- acceptance KPI signoff (latency/cost/quality)
- trial billing / reserved commit
- post-eval runbook for rollout
```
Diego: one more: need labels for edge cases (20 examples) from product to train the hallucination detector.
Ken: confirm acceptance signoff process — Sales approves when all KPIs met for 48 hours under test load and security checklist items completed. Documented rollback/fallback must be tested.
Asha: thanks. next actions: Diego attach prompt suite by EOD; Mira list shareable security docs and infra ETA; Sam confirm pricing formal quote tomorrow; Ken will draft signoff clause. ops-bot: create task -> "ACME-POC-preflight" for infra + security follow-up.
ops-bot: created task ACME-POC-preflight assigned to Mira, due 5 business days from assignment. :white_check_mark:
